Class methods

Source: R/zz_statics.R
class_methods.Rd

Upstream's class and static methods live on the class generators:

Value

The methods return what upstream's class methods of the same names return, as the list above describes.

Details

  • CircleClass$from_three_points(p1, p2, p3, ...): the circle through three points.

  • AngleClass$from_three_points(A, B, C, ...): the angle at B between the lines to A and C.

  • Line3DClass$parallel_to(line, point, length, ...) and Line3DClass$perpendicular_to(line, point, length, ...): a 3D line through point parallel or perpendicular to line.

  • ChangeSpeedClass$add_updater(mobject, update_function, index, call_updater): an updater that follows speed changes (the same as change_speed_add_updater()).

  • MobjectClass$set_default(...) and AnimationClass$set_default(...): set_default() for those base classes.

  • MobjectClass$add_animation_override(animation_class, override_func, mobject_class = MobjectClass): registers an override, as override_animation() does, and errors if the class already has one.

  • TextClass$font_list() and MarkupTextClass$font_list(): the font families installed.

  • TexTemplateClass$from_file(file, ...): a template whose whole body is read from a .tex file.

  • CodeClass$get_styles_list() and CodeClass$get_pygments_style(name): the names and colors of the highlighting styles (all of Pygments' when it is available, see Code()).

  • CodeClass$default_background_config and CodeClass$default_paragraph_config are the class attributes that hold the defaults of background_config and paragraph_config; changing them changes later Code() objects.

  • CairoRendererClass$capabilities: the optional session features of the renderer (live_preview = FALSE).

  • GraphClass$from_igraph(graph, ...) and DiGraphClass$from_igraph(graph, ...): a Graph() or DiGraph() with the vertices (by name when they have names) and edges of an igraph graph, the R counterpart of upstream's Graph.from_networkx(); ... goes to the constructor, for example layout = "spring".

Examples

CircleClass$from_three_points(LEFT, UP, RIGHT)$radius
#> [1] 1
head(TextClass$font_list())
#> [1] "Bitstream Charter"    "C059"                 "Courier"             
#> [4] "D050000L"             "DejaVu Math TeX Gyre" "DejaVu Sans"
